payload.recallText: I began my illustrious career in journalism at Fordham University, in the bronx, as a hard boiled reporter for the fordham Ram. The dean, Dean McGowan, had beeing trying to change the student body of the school in a negative way to be focused less on the hard working middle class, and so I found him on campus and asked him if he had any comments on the situation. He said "Hey Punk, Fuck You" But then an elusive stranger came up and threw a pie in his face. I knew this could be big news so I ran back to my editor Jim and asked if I could write it. He said, that guys a dick, write it up. And so I did, I wrote a story about this stranger, who I coined "Pie Man" and it made page one. Then I got a mysterious letter from this Pie Man asking him to meet me on the steps. I brought the Ram's photographer and we went together to meet the Pie Man. From there we covered five stories about him. Then I went to a bar and this girl I like, Angela, asked me if I was the Pie Man. I lied and said yes. She said "why don't you get me a beer and tell me about it"
